desc:
🛵 DELIVER, EXPLORE & WIN! 🍔

🏙️ Hop on your DoorDash scooter and race around the city delivering orders to customers!

🎵 YOUR RIDE, YOUR MUSIC! Tune into Dash Radio and choose the perfect soundtrack for your deliveries!

🏆 EXCLUSIVE UGC REWARDS! Starting 12/2, reach the Top 40 on the Weekly Leaderboard for a chance to earn an exclusive UGC prize! UGC redemptions open at 1:00 PM ET every Wednesday, following the conclusion of each weekly challenge.

📦 NEW QUESTS! Exciting new quest lines arrive every Wednesday starting 12/2!

🧡 Grab your scooter, hit the streets, and become the city's ultimate delivery driver!
